tpl: Attack Interval slightly reduces; each attack or stored-energy shot grants this unit ATK +{0} and ASPD +{1} for subsequent attacks (stacks up to {2} times; firing Transposed Energy applies 3 stacks), lasting until the skill ends

ASPD +{0}; stored energy, once fired, bounces once between enemies (prioritizing different targets), dealing {1} ATK as Arts damage; Transposed Energy bounces 3 times instead Skill activation grants {2} ammo; 1 ammo is consumed only when firing each stored energy, and firing Transposed Energy consumes 3 ammo; the skill ends when all ammo is used (can manually deactivate skill)
